result.title: UniRestorer++: Scalable Universal Image Restoration with Multi-Granularity Degradation Modeling
result.summary: Universal image restoration aims to handle diverse degradations within a single model, but a reliable scaling strategy remains underexplored. Increasing backbone depth and width can lead to performance saturation, while degradation-aware specialization depends on accurate degradation estimation and is vulnerable to errors on out-of-distribution and real-world inputs. We propose UniRestorer++, a scalable framework based on multi-granularity degradation modeling. It progressively refines degradation groups and introduces group-specific experts, coupling capacity growth with specialization. Degradation-estimation-based routing selects a root-to-leaf path, while granularity-estimation-based routing chooses a level along that path to balance specialization and robustness. Spatially dense degradation representation maps further enable region-aware routing for spatially non-uniform corruptions. We develop CDD-50, a benchmark covering 50 degradation categories from single to penta-degradation. Experiments show approximately log-linear PSNR trends over the evaluated model-size range and stronger scaling gains on out-of-distribution and real-world data than vanilla MoE scaling. UniRestorer++ achieves state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks and demonstrates zero-shot generalization and few-shot transfer on real-world images. Code: https://github.com/mrluin/UniRestorer_plusplus

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 UniRestorer++，通过多粒度退化建模、退化分组专家与基于退化/粒度估计的路由，实现可扩展的通用图像复原，并构建 CDD-50 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究的是低层图像复原中的专家路由与容量扩展，虽涉及估计驱动的层级路由，但不考察多模态推理状态表示、证据使用或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系，也无具体可核查的借鉴线索。
